user.title: Import your horizon
user.description: Choose a PeakFinder Stellarium horizon export (horizon.txt). The coordinates in the file determine the viewpoint. If the file has no coordinates, Terrain Sun uses the Home Assistant location.

set_default_profile.title: Choose default profile
set_default_profile.description: Choose the profile for cards set to Follow default profile.

add_profile.title: Add a profile
add_profile.description: Choose a PeakFinder Stellarium horizon export (horizon.txt). The coordinates in the file determine the viewpoint. If the file has no coordinates, Terrain Sun uses the Home Assistant location.

edit_profile.title: Edit a profile
edit_profile.description: Change the name or select a new horizon.txt for this profile. Leaving the file field empty keeps the terrain data.

remove_profile.title: Remove a profile
remove_profile.description: This removes the profile and its entities. Cards using the profile will go back to the default.

data.confirm: I want to remove the profile and its entities

error.invalid_profile: Could not read the horizon. Use a UTF-8 text file with azimuth and elevation pairs covering the full compass.
error.confirm_removal: Confirm that you want to remove the profile.

abort.default_profile_saved: The default profile has been saved.
abort.last_profile: Terrain Sun needs at least one terrain profile.
abort.unknown_profile: This terrain profile no longer exists.
